title: Contractor cannot enroll in Intune: license group disables the Entra ID P1 prerequisite
narrative: A vendor engineer signs in fine (no sign-in errors) but Company Portal enrollment fails with a licensing error. GRP-LIC-E3-CONTRACTOR was cloned from a cost-reduction template that disables AAD_PREMIUM; INTUNE_A depends on it in the lab model, so group licensing reports a dependency violation and the Intune workload is not usable. The active Intune reporting-delay advisory (IN-LAB-0004) is recorded but is not the cause.
